mapper.select: SELECT member_id memberId,state,display_alias displayName,version,created_at createdAt FROM mbr_member WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND member_id=#{memberId}
SELECT member_id memberId,state,display_alias displayName,version,created_at createdAt FROM mbr_member WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND member_id=#{memberId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE mbr_member SET state=#{toState},version=version+1,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND member_id=#{memberId} AND state=#{fromState} AND version=#{expectedVersion}
mapper.select: SELECT identity_id identityId,member_id memberId,identity_type identityType,masked_value maskedValue, state,key_version keyVersion,bound_at createdAt FROM mbr_identity WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND identity_type=#{identityType} AND lookup_hmac=#{lookupHmac} AND state='ACTIVE'
mapper.update: UPDATE mbr_identity SET state='REVOKED',revoked_by=#{actorUserId},revoked_at=#{occurredAt} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND identity_id=#{identityId} AND member_id=#{memberId} AND state='ACTIVE'
mapper.select: SELECT request_id requestId,member_id memberId,request_type requestType,state,version, submitted_at submittedAt,completed_at completedAt FROM mbr_privacy_request WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND request_id=#{requestId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE mbr_privacy_request SET state=#{toState},version=version+1,completed_at=#{completedAt} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND request_id=#{requestId} AND state=#{fromState} AND version=#{expectedVersion}
mapper.select: SELECT link_id linkId,source_member_id sourceMemberId,target_member_id targetMemberId,action, occurred_at occurredAt FROM mbr_member_link_ledger WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND source_member_id=#{sourceMemberId} ORDER BY occurred_at DESC,link_ledger_id DESC LIMIT 1
